_what: The day-off animations, by the id of the WhatsApp message each one arrived in. The files themselves are not here on purpose: they are somebody else's work, this repository is public, and TimelinesAI is already holding them.
_how_to_add: Send the GIF to the school's own WhatsApp number (+50769027049) from any phone, then read the message id: GET /integrations/api/chats/<chat>/messages?page=1 and take the `uid` of the one with has_attachment. Paste it below with a word about what it is. Nothing else to do.
_how_to_fetch: GET /integrations/api/messages/<uid> returns the message with a fresh `attachment_url`, signed and good for an hour. WhatsApp stores an animation as attachment.mp4, which is what to send back -- it arrives looking the way it did when it was sent in.
_note: Two is thin. Four or five and nobody sees the same one twice in a fortnight.
